debts.title: clients.agent_id / cross_agent_matches column drift broke CRM Clientes and AI matching
debts.description_es: Encontrado en AUDITORIA (R21): el frontend consultaba clients.agent_id (real: assigned_agent_id) y cross_agent_matches.explanation/similarity_score (real: match_explanation/match_score). La función RPC find_cross_agent_matches referenciaba clients.agent_id/embedding (real: assigned_agent_id/preference_embedding vector(768), no vector(1536)) y su search_path excluía public, donde vive la extensión vector, por lo que el operador <=> nunca resolvía. La edge function match-properties insertaba con nombres de columna inexistentes en cross_agent_matches. Resultado: CRM — Clientes nunca cargaba y el matching cross-agent por IA nunca funcionó desde Fase 7/8.
debts.description_en: Found during AUDITORIA (R21): frontend queried clients.agent_id (real: assigned_agent_id) and cross_agent_matches.explanation/similarity_score (real: match_explanation/match_score). RPC find_cross_agent_matches referenced clients.agent_id/embedding (real: assigned_agent_id/preference_embedding vector(768), not vector(1536)) and its search_path excluded public, where the vector extension lives, so the <=> operator never resolved. Edge function match-properties inserted using column names that don't exist on cross_agent_matches. Result: CRM — Clientes never loaded and cross-agent AI matching never worked since Fase 7/8.
debts.fix_es: PR #6 (frontend + RPC column names) y PR #7 (search_path de la función). Migración 07_fix_matching_columns.sql aplicada y verificada en vivo contra mh-systems-platform (nehfrtedwcmdlmbulhef) vía Supabase MCP — smoke test del RPC sin errores, sin nuevas alertas en get_advisors.
debts.fix_en: PR #6 (frontend + RPC column names) and PR #7 (function search_path). Migration 07_fix_matching_columns.sql applied and verified live against mh-systems-platform (nehfrtedwcmdlmbulhef) via Supabase MCP — RPC smoke test ran with no errors, no new get_advisors findings.

debts.title: Legacy FastAPI backend unused by dashboard
debts.description_es: El backend FastAPI completo sigue en el repo pero el dashboard usa supabase-js directo y Edge Functions desde la Fase 8. Su capa de auth no aplica scoping multi-tenant. Candidato a borrado o archivado tras confirmar que ningún servicio (gateway, cron, scraper) lo consume.
debts.description_en: Full FastAPI backend remains in the repo but the dashboard uses supabase-js directly and Edge Functions since Fase 8. Its auth layer lacks multi-tenant scoping. Candidate for deletion or archiving after confirming no service (gateway, cron, scraper) consumes it.
debts.proposed_fix_es: Auditar consumidores → archivar o eliminar backend/ → limpiar docker-compose y ENV asociadas.
debts.proposed_fix_en: Audit consumers → archive or delete backend/ → clean docker-compose and related ENV vars.
